## Process Overview  
**Account Opening Process:**
```
Customer Request
↓
Channel Selection (Branch/Online/Postal)
↓
Application Form Completion
↓
KYC Verification (ID + Address)
↓
AML Screening
↓
Risk Assessment
↓
Approval/Rejection Decision
↓
Account Creation (if approved)
↓
Card Issuance (if applicable)
↓
Customer Notification
↓
Account Activation
```  
**Timeline:** 1–2 business days (online/branch), 5–7 days (postal)

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Process
raw_entities.description: The end-to-end operational workflow for establishing a new customer account. The timeline varies by channel: 1–2 business days for online/branch and 5–7 days for postal applications.

raw_entities.name: Customer Request
raw_entities.description: The initial stage of the account opening process where the customer expresses intent to open an account.

raw_entities.name: Channel Selection
raw_entities.description: The step where the method of application is determined, specifically whether it is processed via Branch, Online, or Postal channels.

raw_entities.name: Application Form Completion
raw_entities.description: The stage where the necessary application forms are filled out by the customer.

raw_entities.name: KYC Verification
raw_entities.description: A step involving the verification of the customer's identity and address documents.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening
raw_entities.description: The process of screening the applicant against Anti-Money Laundering lists and criteria.

raw_entities.name: Risk Assessment
raw_entities.description: The evaluation of the customer's risk profile to determine the suitability of opening the account.

raw_entities.name: Approval or Rejection Decision
raw_entities.description: A critical branching point where the application is either approved for account creation or rejected based on the preceding verification and risk steps.

raw_entities.name: Account Creation
raw_entities.description: The action of establishing the account in the bank's systems, contingent upon the approval decision.

raw_entities.name: Card Issuance
raw_entities.description: The step where a payment card is issued to the customer, if applicable to the chosen product.

raw_entities.name: Customer Notification
raw_entities.description: The stage where the customer is informed of the outcome of their application and the status of their account.

raw_entities.name: Account Activation
raw_entities.description: The final step to make the newly created account operational for the customer.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The individual applying for a new account who initiates the request and completes the application form.
